mapper.insert: insert into breeding_performance (house_id, rabbit_id) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}) on duplicate key update update_time = now()

insert into breeding_performance ( house_id, rabbit_id, total_litters, total_kits, total_live_kits, total_weaned, success_breeding_count, failed_breeding_count, avg_litter_size, avg_weaning_size, last_litter_date ) values ( #{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{totalLitters}, #{totalKits}, #{totalLiveKits}, #{totalWeaned}, #{successBreedingCount}, #{failedBreedingCount}, #{avgLitterSize}, #{avgWeaningSize}, #{lastLitterDate} ) on duplicate key update total_litters = values(total_litters), total_kits = values(total_kits), total_live_kits = values(total_live_kits), total_weaned = values(total_weaned), success_breeding_count = values(success_breeding_count), failed_breeding_count = values(failed_breeding_count), avg_litter_size = values(avg_litter_size), avg_weaning_size = values(avg_weaning_size), last_litter_date = values(last_litter_date), update_time = now()

update.if: update breeding_performance set success_breeding_count = success_breeding_count + 1, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId}
update breeding_performance set failed_breeding_count = failed_breeding_count + 1, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId}

mapper.update: update breeding_performance set total_litters = total_litters + 1, total_kits = total_kits + #{totalKits}, total_live_kits = total_live_kits + #{liveKits}, last_litter_date = #{birthDate}, avg_litter_size = round((total_kits + #{totalKits}) / (total_litters + 1), 2), update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId}

update breeding_performance set total_weaned = total_weaned + #{weaned}, avg_weaning_size = case when total_litters = 0 then 0.00 else round((total_weaned + #{weaned}) / total_litters, 2) end, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId}
mapper.select: select * from breeding_performance where house_id = #{houseId} order by update_time desc, id desc

select ifnull(sum(total_litters), 0) as totalLitters, ifnull(sum(total_kits), 0) as totalKits, ifnull(sum(total_live_kits), 0) as totalLiveKits, ifnull(sum(total_weaned), 0) as totalWeaned, ifnull(sum(success_breeding_count), 0) as successBreedingCount, ifnull(sum(failed_breeding_count), 0) as failedBreedingCount from breeding_performance where house_id = #{houseId}
